record.goal: Prove that every finite group of prime order is cyclic.
record.plan_summary: Prove Lagrange's theorem by cosets, then apply it to the cyclic subgroup generated by a nonidentity element.
subgoals: Prove that left cosets of a subgroup H in a finite group G partition G.
Prove that every left coset gH has cardinality |H| via the bijection h -> gh.
Choose a nonidentity a in G of prime order-size p and apply the divisibility result to H=<a> to get |<a>|=p and hence G=<a>.
motivation: Immediate conclusions show that a nonidentity generated subgroup is enough if its order is forced to be p.
Search results identify Lagrange's theorem as the standard exact key lemma.
The plan avoids black-box external citations by proving Lagrange directly.
